subject: Pre-close check: GPU roster availability for MontageAI POC
messages:
From: Tom Briggs <t.briggs@montage.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@montage.ai>, procurement@montage.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask re: GPU runway for POC (Montage)

Hi Hannah / Aditya —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Montage is ready to move the POC into a 6‑week evaluation and procurement is asking for a short confirmation on capacity before we sign (they want a snapshot to attach to the SOW). Two quick questions:

1) Can you confirm availability for a dedicated pool of 8x A100‑80GB (or compatible equivalents) starting 2026‑07‑12 for ~6 weeks?
2) If capacity is tight, what’s the minimal guaranteed runway you can offer and the blocking mechanism?

We need something simple to show our legal/procurement — a one‑paragraph availability statement plus an inventory snapshot will do.

Ellen (cc) is our procurement lead; copying procurement for timeline.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — can you confirm by EOD PST?

—Tom
Head of Infrastructure, Montage AI

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Briggs <t.briggs@montage.ai>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@montage.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask re: GPU runway for POC (Montage)

Team —

Montage is asking for an availability note + short inventory snapshot to attach to their SOW. They want 8x A100‑80GB (or equivalent) starting 7/12 for 6 weeks. We don’t have to commit long‑term, but procurement wants a runway statement and a blocking/hold option description.

Action items:
- Aditya: can you pull a quick inventory + current reserved commitments and indicate any cluster IDs that could cover this window? If we can’t meet A100s, list compatible variants (A40, H100 Q8 quantized profiles) and expected perf delta. Attach the csv snapshot.
- Karthik: confirm internal policy for short, deal‑level holds (how long can we hold without a signed contract; escalation path if >2 weeks).
- Monica / Marcus: if we need to carve a dedicated pool, estimate the routing/weight implications on existing reserved customers (latency impact / throughput delta).

I’ll respond to Tom/Ellen once we have the snapshot + recommendation. Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Briggs <t.briggs@montage.ai>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@montage.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask re: GPU runway for POC (Montage) — inventory snapshot attached

Hannah / all —

Attached: gpu_inventory_snapshot_20260629.csv (summary + per‑cluster available units). Short summary below: 

- Inventory that meets A100‑80GB class: 6 units immediately available across two dedicated pools (clusters: pool‑east‑03 [3], pool‑west‑02 [3]).
- Equivalent substitution options: H100 (Q8) x8 — we have 9 units free in pool‑west‑01; expected perf ~1.05x for throughput but higher infer cost per token. A40x80 equiv (quantized) — 12 units free but expected perf ~0.7x vs A100 on large sequence lengths.
- Contention notes: week of 7/12 has an internal commit for reserved customers (two >50% utilization bursts anticipated on 7/14 and 7/19). If we commit 8x A100 now, we will need to trigger a temporary burst allocation or shift two reserved nodes to the Montage pool, which impacts SLAs for one legacy reserved customer (we can avoid this with a 7‑day soft hold and a partial H100 substitution).

Recommendation: Provide a conditional availability statement: guarantee 6x A100‑class units starting 7/12 with the option to substitute 2 units with H100 Q8 if the customer signs by 7/06. If they need full 8x A100, require signed SOW + PO by 7/01 to reserve; otherwise we can provide an H100 mix by default.

I attached the snapshot CSV and a short one‑paragraph availability line you can paste into the SOW.

Attachment stub: gpu_inventory_snapshot_20260629.csv (CSV, 34KB)

—Aditya
Capacity Planning Lead, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Briggs <t.briggs@montage.ai>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@montage.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask re: GPU runway for POC (Montage) — policy + hold mechanics

Hannah —

Short version on policy: we can place a deal‑level reservation (internal term: "initiative hold") for up to 14 calendar days without a signed contract; that hold reserves compute in our scheduler and prevents automatic allocation to new on‑demand jobs. To hold beyond 14 days we require an executed SOW or a signed PO and escrow (finance will raise a temporary deposit). Holds are cancellable by ops with 48h notice if we hit critical capacity events — we disclose this in the availability note.

Operational notes:
- To create the hold: create a hold ticket with ID HLD‑<deal_id> (I’ll prefill HLD‑DEAL‑2026‑0431) and include cluster IDs to pin (e.g., pool‑east‑03:node[11..14], pool‑west‑02:node[2..4]).
- If they need A100 specifically and PO is delayed, ops suggests an H100 fallback plan with an automated kernel/quantization mapping. Engineering (Marcus) should confirm perf calibration (<15% expected deviation for our POC workloads).

I’ll approve the HLD ticket once Aditya confirms node list and Marcus signs off on perf tradeoffs.

—Karthik
Head of Dedicated Operations, Redwood Inference

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Tom Briggs <t.briggs@montage.ai>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@montage.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask re: GPU runway for POC (Montage) — availability statement and next steps

Ellen / Tom —

Thanks for the quick ask — below is the availability paragraph you can paste into the SOW plus next steps. If you’re OK with the conditional language, we can attach the inventory snapshot and create the internal hold.

Availability statement (proposed for SOW):
"Redwood Inference confirms conditional availability of compute for Montage AI’s 6‑week POC beginning 2026‑07‑12. We can guarantee allocation of 6x A100‑80GB class GPUs starting 2026‑07‑12 subject to receipt of a signed SOW and PO by 2026‑07‑01. If full availability of 8x A100‑80GB cannot be secured prior to the start date, Redwood will provide a validated H100 (Q8 quantized) substitution for up to 2 units with equivalent operational coverage. Holds will be placed as an initiative hold (HLD‑DEAL‑2026‑0431) for up to 14 calendar days pending contract execution. Redwood reserves the right to reprioritize in case of critical capacity events with at least 48 hours’ notice to Montage."
Next steps:
1) Montage: sign SOW or confirm PO by 2026‑07‑01 to lock 8x A100; if not possible, confirm acceptance of the 6x A100 + 2x H100 substitution.
2) Montage: send signed PO to procurement@redwood.com and upload the SOW to the Drive link (shared).
3) On our side: Aditya will file the HLD ticket and attach gpu_inventory_snapshot_20260629.csv; Karthik will pre‑approve the hold mechanics; Marcus will run quick perf sanity checks on the H100 substitution and share results in the ticket.

I’ll follow up tomorrow with the HLD ticket number and the small SOW paragraph attached as a PDF.

Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: montage_capacity_sow_v3.pdf (6 pages, SOW draft), montage_po_template.docx (procurement template)
